production_metadata.production_description:
Models: Claude Opus 5.5 + GPT-6 Astra.

Produced by Humanfia's LOT (Lean Option Tree) orchestrator: agent sessions recursively split the statement into frozen sub-obligations, prove them in parallel, and every step is checked with the official lean-eval checker (comparator, nanoda and Lean kernel replay). The proof is fully machine-written; humans built the orchestrator and the seed package and operated the infrastructure. Builds on Mathlib; the run started from a seed package containing our own earlier partial work on this problem.
